name: Elina Olegovna Oven
original_name: エリナ・オレゴヴナ・アヴェーン
source:
Russian vampire who transferred to Aqua Eden in order to facilitate the population process. Works as a bunny girl at Casino. Likes to tease but not good when teased herself and is always throwing vulgar jokes to discover other sexual habits. 

Has the ability to control electricity and make electric waves.
